steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for pronouns and negation. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | GCSE Spanish Exam Tips: Direct object pronouns (lo, la, los, las) replace nouns. Indirect object pronouns (le, les) go before the verb. Double object pronouns follow a specific order (se lo, se la). Negation uses no before the verb; double negatives are required (no... nada, no... nunca).

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about pronouns and negation. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on pronouns and negation. | Translate into Spanish: "I think pronouns and negation is important because..."
